## Example: Filtering out extreme distance outliers (histogram)

We’ll compare flight distances before/after removing unrealistic values (> 5000 miles).

```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 4

library(dplyr)
library(nycflights13)

# Put two plots side-by-side
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

## ---- Before cleaning ----
hist(
  flights$distance,
  breaks = seq(0, 10000, by = 100),   # consistent binning
  main = "Before Cleaning",
  xlab  = "Distance (miles)",
  xlim  = c(0, 10000)                 # shows long right tail
)

## ---- After cleaning ----
filtered <- flights %>%
  filter(distance < 5000) %>%
  pull(distance)

hist(
  filtered,
  breaks = seq(0, 10000, by = 100),   # same bins for fair comparison
  main = "After Cleaning",
  xlab  = "Distance (miles)",
  xlim  = c(0, 10000)
)

# Reset plotting layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
